title: Microsoft Purview Endpoint DLP: OCR scanning of images on Windows devices (GCC, GCC High, DoD)
summary: The briefing accurately reports the government-cloud roadmap target and distinguishes it from the documented OCR design and unresolved government-cloud billing. The controls, licensing statements and limits are supported; two paths could be more complete, and a related Microsoft page still describes the Purview OCR settings as preview.

claims.claim: OCR applies existing DLP policies to image and text content rather than providing a separate rule action.
claims.quote: When you configure the OCR settings, Microsoft Purview applies your existing policies for data loss prevention (DLP), records management, and insider risk management (IRM) to images and text-based content.

claims.claim: The content contains sensitive information condition with the Credit Card SIT scans both image and text content at selected locations.
claims.quote: if you configure the DLP condition content contains sensitive information and include a data classifier such as the Credit Card sensitive information type (SIT), Microsoft Purview scans for credit card numbers in both text and images at all of the chosen locations.
